app.name: Imposter Party
onboarding.1.title: Все в деле. Один лжёт.
onboarding.1.body: Передавайте телефон. Все видят одно секретное слово — кроме одного. Это самозванец.
onboarding.2.title: Дай подсказку, но не выдай
onboarding.2.body: Твой ход: намекни на слово, не называя его. Подмигни знающим, обмани самозванца. Он же просто блефует.
onboarding.3.title: Говори, подозревай, разоблачай
onboarding.3.body: Обсудите и укажите на подозреваемого. Угадали — победа; самозванец ускользнул — раунд за ним.
tutorial.1.title: Выбери колоду
tutorial.1.body: Выбери темы — или нажми Удиви меня, и приложение сдаст карты.
tutorial.2.title: Зажми, чтобы глянуть
tutorial.2.body: Карта запечатана. Зажми палец, чтобы открыть — отпусти, и она закроется. Никто не подглядит через плечо.
tutorial.3.title: Твоя очередь
tutorial.3.body: Приложение вызывает игроков по очереди. Дай одну умную подсказку — ясную для своих, запутанную для самозванца.
tutorial.4.title: Обвини и разоблачи
tutorial.4.body: Спорьте, укажите на подозреваемого и откройте правду.
tutorial.4.warning: Если самозванец угадает слово до конца времени — мгновенная победа

howto.classic.1.title: Pick your themes
howto.classic.1.body: Choose one or more packs. The secret word comes from those themes.
howto.classic.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.classic.2.body: Your card is sealed. Hold your finger to open it — let go and it closes. Nobody peeks over your shoulder.
howto.classic.3.title: Say one smart clue
howto.classic.3.body: When it's your turn, describe the word without saying it. Help allies — confuse the imposter.
howto.classic.4.title: Debate & expose
howto.classic.4.body: Talk it out, then accuse the suspect. Find the imposter and the crew wins.
howto.classic.4.warning: If the imposter guesses the secret word early, they win instantly.
howto.chain.1.title: Pick themes for the chain
howto.chain.1.body: Choose packs as usual. Everyone will build one shared clue chain from that word.
howto.chain.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.chain.2.body: See your role in private. Most players see the word; the imposter doesn't.
howto.chain.3.title: Add one word to the chain
howto.chain.3.body: On your turn, say only ONE word that links to the words before you. No sentences — keep the chain growing.
howto.chain.4.title: Spot the weak link
howto.chain.4.body: Weird links stand out. Debate who broke the chain, then vote to expose the imposter.
howto.chain.4.warning: A forced or random word often reveals the imposter — listen closely.
howto.doubleAgent.1.title: Two words in play
howto.doubleAgent.1.body: Pick themes. Most players get the real secret word — imposters get a convincing decoy instead.
howto.doubleAgent.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.doubleAgent.2.body: You won't see IMPOSTER written. Everyone thinks they know the word — but some hold a fake.
howto.doubleAgent.3.title: Describe YOUR word
howto.doubleAgent.3.body: Give clues for the word on your card. If yours is the decoy, your clues will feel slightly off.
howto.doubleAgent.4.title: Find who has the fake
howto.doubleAgent.4.body: Listen for mismatched details. Accuse the double agent before they blend in.
howto.doubleAgent.4.warning: There is no IMPOSTER label — the decoy is the trap.
howto.emoji.1.title: Themes, no talking
howto.emoji.1.body: Choose packs. Clues in this mode are emoji-only — no spoken words allowed.
howto.emoji.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.emoji.2.body: Check your role privately. Most see the secret word; the imposter must bluff with emojis.
howto.emoji.3.title: Clue with emojis only
howto.emoji.3.body: On your turn, show emoji clues (on another phone or act them out). No letters, no saying the word.
howto.emoji.4.title: Read the faces
howto.emoji.4.body: Odd emoji choices give people away. Debate, then vote out the imposter.
howto.emoji.4.warning: Speaking the word or spelling it breaks the mode — stick to emojis.
howto.rapid.1.title: Fast themes
howto.rapid.1.body: Choose packs. This mode is short, loud, and tense — every clue has a countdown.
howto.rapid.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.rapid.2.body: See your role quickly. Same secrecy rules — sealed card, hold to open.
howto.rapid.3.title: Clue before time runs out
howto.rapid.3.body: Each player gets about 12 seconds. Say one clue fast — when the timer hits zero, the turn auto-advances.
howto.rapid.4.title: Quick debate, then vote
howto.rapid.4.body: After the rapid round, discuss briefly and accuse. Hesitation is a clue too.
howto.rapid.4.warning: Некогда раздумывать — быстрые ответы могут выдать самозванца.
howto.drawing.1.title: Pick draw themes
howto.drawing.1.body: Choose packs. You'll hint with drawings instead of spoken clues.
howto.drawing.2.title: Hold to peek
howto.drawing.2.body: Check your role in private. Most see the word; the imposter must invent a drawing that fits in.
howto.drawing.3.title: Один штрих — и передай
howto.drawing.3.body: When it's your turn, draw a single-stroke hint on the canvas, then hand the phone to the next player.
howto.drawing.4.title: Изучи каракули
howto.drawing.4.body: Awkward or too-safe drawings stand out. Vote to expose the imposter.
howto.drawing.4.warning: Писать буквы или слово — читерство: только рисуй.
